message: You know that friend who always panics during a fire drill? Yep, that’s my buddy Mark. Last week, we were cooking up a storm for a potluck when he suddenly yelled, "What if the smoke alarm goes off?!" I had to laugh because, honestly, I think it’s just his way of showing he cares. 😅 We took a minute to chat about our escape plan and the importance of knowing how to use a fire extinguisher. It was a good reminder that being prepared can help keep those panicky feelings at bay. Ever had a moment like that with a friend?
